purpose: Correct rare peak/void tail morphology without post-hoc field rescaling or independent-test tuning

loss.frequency_fit: Equal-source average of TNG-train and SIMBA-CV16-23-train voxel probabilities only
loss.tail_weight: inverse square root of bin probability, normalized to mean one and capped at ten before renormalization
loss.objective: 0.5 original EDM denoising + 0.5 tail-weighted EDM denoising

development_selection.selection: Select the smallest step that passes all eight unchanged field checks in both development domains
development_selection.failure: If no step passes both domains, declare V9 failed and do not inspect historical SIMBA stress or sealed EAGLE

independence.historical_simba_cv0_15: Stress test only; already inspected after V7 and never used for V9 selection
independence.eagle_confirmation32: Only new independent V9 test; open once only after development and historical stress pass
